_parser_fn_note: READ-ONLY migration, by design - this profile intentionally has NO writer_fn. parser_fn wraps settings_parser._parse_sf6 verbatim (config_manager/profile_functions.py) so extract_key_settings()'s profile-first branch is a zero-behaviour-change read migration. upscaling_mode and frame_generation are hardcoded 'N/A' by the legacy parser itself (SF6's config.ini genuinely has no such fields - confirmed by reading _parse_sf6's body), not something this profile invents. WHY NO writer_fn: unlike GTA (real guarded writer lives elsewhere, bypassing write_settings()) this is a genuine, fully-confirmed dead end - no _write_sf6 function exists anywhere in the codebase, settings_writer.py's _detect_parser_type() has an explicit, pre-existing 'if "street fighter 6" in name_lower: return "unknown"' guard with the comment 'Read-only: SF6 has a dedicated parser but no writer; its INI is not an Unreal GameUserSettings file', CHANGELOG.md documents 'Street Fighter 6 stays read-only', and tests/test_write_safety.py::test_unknown_xml_is_not_sent_to_forza_writer already asserts _detect_parser_type returns 'unknown' for this title. Nothing about this migration changes any of that - write_settings() called for this game continues to hit its generic else-branch and report {status:'skipped', detail:"Unknown parser type for 'Street Fighter 6'"}, exactly as before this profile existed.
